title: How do I restore an archived survey?
intent: This article explains how to restore a previously archived survey.
short_answer: To restore an archived survey, navigate to the Archived Surveys section and click 'Restore' on the desired survey. The system restores the survey and its contributions back to the active survey list.
prerequisites: The archive must exist and not be corrupted
procedure: Navigate to the Archived Surveys section.
Wait for the restore process to complete.
The survey reappears in your active surveys list.
important_conditions: Restoring recreates the survey from the archive package.
The restored survey returns to an unpublished state.
If files are missing from the archive, a warning is shown after restore.
The restore process may take time for large surveys.
You will receive a notification when the restore is complete.
troubleshooting: 'Problem during restore': Some files could not be restored. Check for missing files and re-upload if needed.
